---
name: Bug report
about: Report a reproducible problem
---

## What happened?

Describe what you expected and what happened instead.

## Reproduction

Include steps against a disposable repository, the image digest or source
revision, Gitea version, MCP client/version, and deployment topology.

## Diagnostics

Include only redacted errors. Do not include tokens, passwords, secret values,
or private repository content. Report security vulnerabilities privately as
described in SECURITY.md.
